body.statement: When \(\Gamma=0\), \(d_{\pi xc}=0\) exactly when \(c(x)=\pi(x)\) and equals one otherwise, so \(\overline W(S)=\max_{\pi\in\mathcal F}\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}q_x\mathbf1\{c(x)\neq\pi(x)\text{ for every }c\in S\}\). In particular, exact matching coverage of every future cell gives zero width.
body.justification: This boundary case verifies that the causal width collapses to the established weighted maximum-coverage objective when score sensitivity vanishes.
body.gap: HochbaumPathria1998 supplies the maximum-coverage algorithmic benchmark; this proposition identifies it as the exact \(\Gamma=0\) specialization of the causal width rather than claiming a new coverage theorem.
body.consumer: Practitioners can check the implementation against a transparent coverage instance before using nonzero score sensitivity.
